phrase.zh: 相遇之后，粒子显出波的模样。
phrase.en: An encounter reveals the wave within the particle.

visual.zh: 巨大的晶体切面从左下越出画面，细线落在上表面，弧线从接触处向右上逐层展开；细密刻线衬出晶体的棱角。
visual.en: A large faceted crystal crops beyond the lower left. A fine line meets its upper face, and arcs spread from that point toward the upper right. Fine hatching defines the crystal edges.

background.zh:
戴维森与乔治·佩吉特·汤姆孙因实验发现电子被晶体衍射，共享1937年诺贝尔物理学奖，各获一半。戴维森的研究通过电子在晶体表面的散射，检验电子的波动性质。画面用镍晶体、入射细线和展开的弧线表达这一相遇；弧线是原创寓意，不是电子实际轨迹、实验设备复原或测量结果。短句为原创。
1937年物理学奖；获得本年度奖项的一半。获奖理由（中文译述）：实验发现电子被晶体衍射
background.en:
Davisson and George Paget Thomson shared the 1937 Nobel Prize in Physics equally for experimentally discovering electron diffraction by crystals. Davisson studied electrons scattered at a crystal surface to test their wave behavior. The nickel crystal, incoming fine trace and opening arcs form an original metaphor for that encounter. The arcs are not electron trajectories, a reconstruction of apparatus or measured results. The phrase is original.
1937 — The Nobel Prize in Physics. Received half of the prize. Official motivation: for their experimental discovery of the diffraction of electrons by crystals
